aicla.title: AICLA NSW/ACT Webinar – Utmost Good Faith, Misrepresentation & Non-Disclosure
aicla.description:
The AICLA NSW/ACT Division is pleased to invite you to our upcoming webinar, presented by Jonathan Liberis and Justin Khouri of Wotton + Kearney.

“Utmost Good Faith, Misrepresentation & Non-Disclosure”

A common issue arising across all claim lines is the interplay between an insured’s, and insurer’s, duty of utmost good faith and misrepresentations or non-disclosures made prior to policy inception.

This presentation will examine the courts’ current approach to these issues and explore the circumstances in which misrepresentations and non-disclosures can impact an insured’s entitlement under a policy. Attendees will gain valuable insight into the practical application of these principles and their relevance to claims handling.

Perfect for claims professionals, loss adjusters, brokers, underwriters, and anyone looking to strengthen their technical insurance knowledge.

📅 Wednesday, 21 October 2026
🕐 1:00pm – 2:00pm AEDT
✅ Open to all AICLA members
✅ No cost to attend

AICLA CPD: 1 Point

To register and add this event to your calendar

aicla.title: SA/NT Seminar: Recovery 101
aicla.description:
Recovery can be one of the trickiest parts of a claim, sometimes straightforward, sometimes anything but!

Join us for a practical session exploring recovery opportunities, common pitfalls and the issues that can make getting money back a little more complicated than simply sending an invoice.

Our final educational event for the year promises useful insights, real-world discussion and hopefully a few lessons worth recovering too.
